result.effect: V1: 252 nodes, 931 edges, average degree 7.39, density 0.029, transitivity 0.35, average clustering coefficient 0.11; V2: 219 nodes, 665 edges, average degree 6.07, density 0.028, transitivity 0.33, average clustering coefficient 0.06

cells.quote: Most network indicators, including the number of nodes, number of edges, average degree, network density, network transitivity and average clustering coefficient, are larger for the V1 KPN than for the V2 KPN.
cells.note: The study compares pre-existing examination volumes; no learning intervention or learner sample is described.

cells.quote: The Fd metric proposed in this article shows a similar trend, with a higher value for the V1 KPN.
cells.note: Fd is a network-derived examination-difficulty metric, not a learner-performance outcome.

result.effect: V1 was more difficult in 11 of 15 years

cells.quote: The difficulty of V1 is consistently higher than V2 for most years, with the exception of the period between 2009 and 2012, during which V1 was less difficult than V2.
cells.note: The study reports a year-by-year pattern with exceptions, so the direction is coded mixed.
